text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein stresses need to overcome crisis in Middle East peace talks brought about by Jerusalem bombing.
- Rural Development Bank provides local village councils with loans to rehabilitate road networks.
- Prime Minister Majali says peace process moving ahead despite all obstacles.
- Government appears set to choose November 4 as parliamentary election date; Interior Ministry expects 700,000 voters on electoral list.
- Jordan and Iraq discuss expanding trade ties.
- Majali says existing Israeli government is responsible for halt in peace process.
- King voices deep concern over peace crisis and calls on all to work for peace.
